name: Guided Onboarding & Starter Org Generation
objectives: Verify onboarding input validation rejects unsupported org types or autonomy modes
Verify onboarding correctly applies templates based on selected org type
Verify environment doctor check successfully detects missing or present credentials
Verify doctor recommends Claude runtime when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present
Verify doctor recommends fallback runtime when credentials are missing
Verify onboarding generates starter company, goal, and roles correctly
Verify initial task is generated and pushed to active queue
Verify onboarding in live mode is blocked without a valid OWNER_APPROVED_ONBOARDING_TOKEN prefix
Verify invalid runtime recommendation behaves gracefully
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 1.4A and propagates failures correctly
